Flagship.name: Flagship
Flagship.desc: Supreme command vessel with 5 weapon slots (starting with 2 Pulse Lasers & 2 Flak Pods) that stays close to friendly ships. Limit 1 active.

AdvancedCorvette.name: Valkyrie Interceptor
AdvancedCorvette.desc: High-velocity interceptor specialized in applying EMP and Slow debuffs to priority enemy targets.

Capital.name: Command Dreadnought
Capital.desc: Heavy flagship starting with a Gauss Railgun and 6 total modular slots.

Corvette.name: Viper Corvette
Corvette.desc: Agile, high-speed escort ship armed with a rapid Pulse Laser.

Frigate.name: Aegis Frigate
Frigate.desc: Versatile line warship starting with an AoE Plasma Cannon.

Destroyer.name: Nova Destroyer
Destroyer.desc: Artillery platform starting with Valkyrie Missiles and 3 weapon slots.

Cruiser.name: Bastion Cruiser
Cruiser.desc: Frontline hull with heavy armor plating and 3 utility slots.

Carrier.name: Solaris Carrier
Carrier.desc: Flight-deck command ship that deploys autonomous Strike Drones during combat.

BloodTick.name: The Blood-Tick
BloodTick.desc: Fast, aggressive, and entirely focused on disabling prey and getting in close.

JunkFly.name: The Junk-Fly
JunkFly.desc: Cheap, incredibly fragile automated defense drones.

IronBastard.name: The Iron Bastard
IronBastard.desc: A terrifying, sluggish fortress of scrap metal.

FreelanceHive.name: The Freelance Hive
FreelanceHive.desc: A deep-space staging ship that avoids the frontline.

Needle.name: The Needle
Needle.desc: An incredibly fast, fragile skirmisher that relies on electronic warfare and blinding speed to survive.

HiveMindCarrier.name: Hive-Mind Heavy Carrier
HiveMindCarrier.desc: A sprawling, heavily armored mobile command station designed to flood the sector with Strike Wings.

Barracuda.name: Barracuda Torpedo Skimmer
Barracuda.desc: A lightning-fast, fragile strike craft designed to outmaneuver enemy lines.

IroncladGunboat.name: Ironclad Gunboat
IroncladGunboat.desc: A heavily plated brawler designed to drift between enemy formations and unleash staggering kinetic barrages.
